purpose: Frozen reference benchmark for the corrected M5 regularized-logistic TT model. Future models must be compared against this benchmark, not quietly replace it. Any legitimate future change to the evaluation contract is a new BENCHMARK_V2; V1 is never overwritten.

rules: FT present and unequal -> VERIFIED (source PERIODS_FT), ft authoritative over periods and top-level scores
No FT, >=2 legal periods (max>=11, gap>=2), clear majority -> VERIFIED (DERIVED_PERIODS); majority conflicting with a plausible 0-3 top -> VOID (TOP_PERIODS_CONFLICT)
No FT, >=2 legal periods tied -> VOID (PERIODS_TIED)
No FT, 1 legal period + plausible top game count 0-3 consistent -> VERIFIED (TOP_LEVEL_FALLBACK)
No FT, 1 legal period + top inconsistent/implausible -> VOID (TOP_GAME_CONFLICT) or VERIFIED (SINGLE_GAME) on game evidence alone
No FT, top 0-3 unequal, no usable periods -> VERIFIED (TOP_LEVEL_FALLBACK)
No usable evidence -> UNRESOLVED (NO_SCORE_DATA / TOP_IMPLAUSIBLE) - never invents a winner
VOID/UNRESOLVED rows are persisted with equal scores so the eval suite excludes them

model.name: M5_REGULARIZED_LOGISTIC
model.implementation: regularized logistic regression on Elo-derived features

evaluation.walk_forward_definition: strict chronological walk-forward; training window 100 most recent eligible events per participant pair; eval start 2026-03-08; min 5 prior games; binary outcomes only; paired deltas blocked by day
evaluation.reproducibility: two identical runs 2026-08-18T19:46:40Z and 2026-08-18T19:53:32Z (identical manifest SHA256, identical numbers)

data_completion.wtt_feeder_berlin: SKIPPED - probe found 0 historical events in 3 sampled windows (no provider coverage)

event_set.source: tt_match_results rows with a complete outcome (draws excluded: 1194 equal-score rows)
event_set.eligibility: binary labels only (actual in {0,1}); side A = home; min_games >= 5 prior eligible events per participant; event ts >= 2026-03-08 (eval_start)
event_set.dataset_snapshot_id: sha1 of the dataset record json = ae4d5e9c702a09a849294b3ddd6c41477775a946

split_definition.walk_forward: strict chronological; cutoffs every 30 days from eval_start; final window ends at last record + 1 day
split_definition.window_train: events with ts < window start; M5 is fit per window on this train set only
split_definition.window_test: events with ts in [window start, window end) and eligible (available=True)
split_definition.min_train_for_m5: n_train >= 200, otherwise M5 emits no predictions for that window (fail-safe, no silent retrain)
split_definition.windows: W00..W05 (6 windows, boundaries recorded per window in the run manifest)
split_definition.duplicate_guard: duplicate event key inside a window raises RuntimeError

metric_definitions.brier: (p - actual)^2 per event, averaged over the evaluation set; rounded to 6dp in reports
metric_definitions.log_loss: -log(p) when actual = 1, -log(1 - p) when actual = 0; p clipped to [1e-9, 1 - 1e-9]; averaged; rounded to 6dp
metric_definitions.accuracy: share of (p > 0.5 and actual > 0.5) or (p < 0.5 and actual < 0.5); NOT_APPLICABLE when every p is exactly 0.5
metric_definitions.M0A_CONSTANT_0_5: p = 0.5 exactly (sanity anchor; its log loss must equal -ln(0.5) = 0.693147)
metric_definitions.M0B_TRAIN_BASE_RATE: per-window base rate = wins/n_train when n_train >= 100 else 0.5; clipped to [0.001, 0.999]
metric_definitions.M1_CURRENT_ELO: Elo probability from current ratings (K=32, window=100)

model_fit_recipe.algorithm: L2-regularized logistic regression via Newton-Raphson (numpy only), explicit intercept column
model_fit_recipe.weights_documentation: M5_V1 has NO single frozen weight vector: weights are per-window fits recorded in the run output (intercept + 9 feature weights, model_version = '<code>@2026-08-18-audit>:<sha256(weights)[:12]>' per window); reproducibility comes from deterministic fit + fixed seed, not from one artifact

calibration_recipe.bucket_assignment: first bucket whose upper edge strictly exceeds p
calibration_recipe.bucket_status: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE below min n; OK when |observed - mean_p| < 0.05; OVERCONFIDENT when observed < mean_p; UNDERCONFIDENT otherwise
calibration_recipe.weighted_ace: sum(n * |observed_win_rate - mean_predicted_p|) / sum(n) over populated buckets with n >= 30; reference value 0.0109

bootstrap_recipe.purpose: 95% CI for paired model deltas (M5 vs M0A / M0B / M1) over the common event-key intersection
bootstrap_recipe.pairing: per-event paired difference; pairwise event sets must be identical (only_m5 / only_base -> RuntimeError)
bootstrap_recipe.blocking: resample DAY blocks with replacement (block = competition when <= 2 distinct day blocks); within-block dependence preserved

leakage_rules: Strict chronological walk-forward: a window's M5 fit sees only events with ts < window start; nothing from the future is used to fit
All features (Elo, recency Elo window 100, form 5, h2h, rest, degree) are computed from history strictly before the event's own timestamp
Labels are binary only; equal-score (draw) rows are excluded from the label domain - never soft labels
M5 predictions require n_train >= 200 (no silent retrain on thin windows)
Duplicate event keys within a window raise RuntimeError; pairwise delta sets must be exactly equal
M0A constant 0.5 acts as the sanity anchor (exact log loss 0.693147)
immutability_policy: This file and its hashes are frozen; any legitimate future change to the contract is BENCHMARK_V2 and never edits V1
M5_V1 must not be retrained or silently replaced; comparison against V1 numbers requires the identical contract

identity_merges.policy: reversible canonicalization only: explicit aliases in tt_participant_aliases with provider evidence (shared Odds-API.io participant ID); no fuzzy name merging

merges.reverse_if: DELETE alias rows for participant from tt_participant_aliases

identity_merges.benchmark_note: tt_match_results / tt_rating_history / labels are NOT rewritten by merges; the canonical identity layer is tt_participants + tt_participant_aliases (forecast_store.participant_by_normalized resolves alias names to the canonical participant)

uniqueness_invariant.idempotent: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS; re-migrate returns 4
uniqueness_invariant.ingestion: ON CONFLICT (source_id, provider_event_id) DO NOTHING preserved unchanged
